1) **Run AUB module autopilot and auto-select best**
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```

- A new candidate/champion JSON written (or an updated pointer to the selected best)
